**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User is preparing for an upcoming team meeting.  
[EVENT] User has a team meeting scheduled for January 17th.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for tips on active listening and conflict resolution.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Active listening is a crucial communication skill that involves fully concentrating on what the other person is saying, understanding their perspective, and responding appropriately.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for active listening include giving the speaker undivided attention, using verbal and non-verbal cues, paraphrasing and summarizing, avoiding interruptions, and practicing empathy.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Resources for active listening include "The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People" by Stephen Covey, "Active Listening: The Art of Empathetic Conversation" by MindTools, and "The Power of Active Listening" by Harvard Business Review.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Conflict resolution involves finding a mutually beneficial solution to a disagreement or issue.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for conflict resolution include staying calm, focusing on the issue, using "I" statements, seeking common ground, and being open to compromise.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Resources for conflict resolution include "Crucial Conversations: Tools for Talking When Stakes Are High" by Kerry Patterson et al., "Conflict Resolution: A Guide to Resolving Disputes and Improving Communication" by MindTools, and "How to Resolve Conflicts at Work" by Coursera.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips for the team meeting include preparing an agenda, encouraging open communication, taking notes, and following up after the meeting.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggestions for prioritizing tasks and allocating time for each discussion topic include identifying important topics, categorizing topics by urgency and impact, and considering the team's goals and objectives.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggestions for allocating time include assigning time blocks, using a "parking lot" for non-essential topics, leaving buffers between topics, allowing time for questions, and being mindful of meeting duration.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] An agenda template was provided, including columns for Topic, Priority, Time Allocation, and Objective.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggestions for handling off-agenda topics include acknowledging and validating the concern, evaluating the urgency, adding it to the parking lot, scheduling a separate discussion, providing a brief update, or delegating to a smaller group.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggestions for effective note-taking during the meeting include choosing a note-taking method, focusing on key information, using a template, using abbreviations, and reviewing and clarifying notes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] After the meeting, suggestions include reviewing and organizing notes, identifying action items, creating a summary or minutes, sharing notes, and storing them in
